items.title: Show HN: I worked on a new browser for 2 years, today it passed Acid 3
items.connectionNote: A developer spent two years building a browser from scratch that passes Acid3 — a powerful example of the kind of deep, sustained focus on one project that Sean aspires to (#90, #91, #160) and a counter to his pattern of scattering across ideas.
